tools.name: clear_ice_info
tools.description: Facts about Clear Ice Switzerland: product, formats, delivery, minimum order, payment, contact. / Fakten zu Clear Ice Schweiz: Produkt, Formate, Lieferung, Mindestbestellwert, Zahlung, Kontakt.

tools.name: clear_ice_quote
tools.description: Exact shop price (CHF, delivery included) for up to 10 formats of 40–140 mm; quantities round up to full packs. Lead with the price, then one next step: order link (private/event) or clear_ice_request_offer (business). Over 140 mm (up to 200): on request only, no price. / Exakter Shop-Preis (CHF ink

tools.name: clear_ice_order_link
tools.description: Shop link with the cart pre-filled (up to 10 formats of 40–140 mm, full packs); the customer orders there. Best next step for private and event customers. / Shop-Link mit Warenkorb (Formate bis 140 mm), die Bestellung schliesst der Kunde dort ab. Nächster Schritt für Privat- und Eventkunden.

tools.name: clear_ice_formats
tools.description: Common ice formats with typical use (whisky, long drinks, tumblers, tasting) and pieces per pack. / Gängige Formate mit Verwendung und Stück pro Packung.

tools.name: clear_ice_request_offer
tools.description: Sends an offer request to Clear Ice Schweiz on behalf of the user (like the contact form): company, name, e-mail and optional postcode and town, formats (40–200 mm), date, use and message. tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Clear Ice Schweiz facts (product, formats, price examples, delivery, payment, contact). Returns documents with id, title and url; read them with fetch. / Sucht in den Fakten zu Clear Ice Schweiz.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full text of a Clear Ice document found with search. / Volltext eines Dokuments aus search.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "clear_ice_request_offer" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Sends an offer request to Clear Ice Schweiz on behalf of the user (like the contact form): company, name, e-mail and optional postcode and town, formats (40–200…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search · Private data: clear_ice_info, clear_ice_quote, clear_ice_order_link, clear_ice_request_offer, search, fetch · Public sink: clear_ice_request_offer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search · Private data: clear_ice_info, clear_ice_quote, clear_ice_order_link, clear_ice_request_offer, search, fetch · Public sink: clear_ice_request_offer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
